facts.title: Frontend Engineer II
facts.detail: D2C commerce startup (home goods), ~40 engineers, storefront + mobile web.
highlights: Rebuilt the three-step checkout as a single-page flow in React and TypeScript with optimistic cart updates; checkout conversion rose 9.4% in the A/B test and LCP on the payment step dropped from 4.1s to 1.9s.
Own Kite UI, the shared React component library (42 components, typed tokens, Storybook docs) used by 3 product squads.
Led the storefront migration to React 18 and Vite, removing the legacy CRA build and cutting local build times.
Ran a WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit of checkout with design and fixed the critical issues (focus order, labels, colour contrast, screen-reader announcements for cart updates).
Mentored 2 frontend interns through their 6-month internships; both received full-time offers.

slots.text: I care about motion, design systems and the details that make a product feel finished.
Frontend Engineer II at Kitebird who rebuilt checkout, lifting conversion 9.4%, and owns Kite UI, a component library used by 3 product squads.

Earlier at Kitebird, built the backend-for-frontend for the mobile web app in Node.js and Express. Maintains motion-kit, a spring-physics animation library for React with 212 GitHub stars. Started as a freelance UI developer for 3 early-stage clients.
Kitebird Frontend Engineer Rebuilds Checkout; Conversion Rises 9.4%
Riya Kapoor cut LCP on the payment step from 4.1s to 1.9s and also owns Kite UI, the shared component library of 42 components.

Rebuilt the three-step checkout as a single-page flow in React and TypeScript: conversion rose 9.4% in the A/B test and LCP on the payment step dropped from 4.1s to 1.9s.
Own Kite UI, the shared component library of 42 components used by 3 product squads.
Mentored 2 frontend interns.

Built the backend-for-frontend in Node.js and Express for the mobile web app, with one typed endpoint per screen.
Owned API contracts with 2 backend teams and wrote the client-side data layer.
Set up preview deployments for every pull request with GitHub Actions and Vercel.

Built dashboard widgets, including cash-flow charts and invoice tables, in React with TypeScript and Recharts.
Fixed table rendering performance for accounts with 10,000+ invoices using virtualised lists.

Designed and built marketing sites and a component kit for 3 early-stage clients with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Figma.
Delivered responsive, animated landing pages and handed over a reusable design system to each client.

Ran weekly React workshops for 60+ students.
Organised a 24-hour campus hackathon.

Maintains motion-kit, a spring-physics animation library for React with 212 GitHub stars.
Reviews community PRs.
motion-kit is a spring-physics animation library for React with gesture support and reduced-motion handling. Riya maintains it, reviews community PRs, and it has 212 GitHub stars.
checkout-lab is a playground for checkout UX patterns: optimistic updates, address autocomplete and skeleton states. Built with Next.js, with local LCP and INP numbers for each experiment.
design-tokens is a Style Dictionary pipeline that turns Figma variables into CSS, TypeScript and Tailwind tokens. One D2C storefront, Kite UI, uses it in production.
Kite UI docs is the public Storybook for Kitebird's component library. The repo is internal and the docs site is public.
notes-ai lets you ask questions about your markdown notes. It uses OpenAI embeddings, a local vector index and GPT answers, built with TypeScript and Next.js.
recipe-genie-web is the code export of Recipe Genie, built with Lovable. It suggests dinner ideas from what is in your fridge, using Supabase and OpenAI.
a11y-checklist is a practical accessibility checklist for React component libraries. It includes focus-management and live-region examples, written in MDX.
trpc-starter is a starter built on Express, tRPC, Prisma and PostgreSQL. It comes with auth and typed API clients.
